Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: Added: every new install comes with the trackers of all jobs already imported and active; Presets > Import all presets again brings back any you deleted. Added: Sacred Sight aura for the White Mage, with the sigils for the stacks left and a timer that fades the arcs as it runs out. Added: Trust and Duty Support NPCs show in the party frame. Added: Mouseover actions, a checkbox in General (off by default): the action goes to the frame under the cursor. Added: Resize everything, a slider that makes the whole interface bigger or smaller with a live preview and a way back to 100%. Added: separate White Mana and Black Mana numbers for the Red Mage. Added: space between pips chosen per row in the job gauges, and separate spacing for the White Mage lilies and blood lilies. Added: /nui setup in the list of commands. Changed: the trackers of every job share four rows (Rotation, CDs, Defensive CDs and Role Actions): each job only shows its own, they grow from the center with 3 px between icons. Changed: every tracker has the same look: pulse when an effect is on you, timer centered in size 12, stacks at the bottom right in size 9. Changed: job gauge rows and trackers appear only once you have unlocked them (lilies at level 52, blood lilies at 74, Leylines after its quest). Changed: the interface hides when the game hides its own (cutscenes, loading, talks, shops), but stays when you use a quest item or open a gate. Changed: the alliance list is ordered by role; the Limit Break ready border is white; fields and buttons have more contrast; frames light up under the cursor; the menu has margins, drags from its background and folds its cards when you release the button; the windows of Unlock Mode are rounded. Fix: no element can end up outside the screen anymore: it stops at the edge, and what was attached to a group of a job follows the shared group that replaced it. Fix: Peloton is one tracker for every job, with its cooldown for Bard, Machinist and Dancer. Fix: role actions (Lucid Dreaming, Surecast, Rescue...) are shown as soon as any class of the role has learned them. Fix: Thunder is in the rotation debuffs filter. Fix: debuffs in the enmity list were shifted when there were no buffs.
